# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User wants all future updates based on the latest GitHub code path where Plex is removed and media playback uses their Xtream link, while keeping app release/runtime at version 1.0.14.
- Always use the EAS `production` profile/channel for release builds and OTA work; the redundant `firetv` build profile was removed. Fire TV APKs use the production Android APK profile.
